# Ecclesiastes Chapter 9 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**9:1** For all this [et kol zeh] I-took [natati] to my-heart [el libbi], and-to-explain [ve-la-vur] all this [et kol zeh]: that the-righteous [ha-tzaddiqim] and-the-wise [ve-ha-chakhamim] and-their-works [va-avadehem] [are] in-the-hand [be-yad] of-God [ha-Elohim]; whether [gam] love [ahavah] or [gam] hatred [sin'ah], the-human [ha-adam] does-not-know [ein yode'a]; all [ha-kol] [is] before-them [lifnehem].

**9:2** All [ha-kol] [is] as [ka-asher] to-all [la-kol]: one [miqreh echad] fate [is] to-the-righteous [la-tzaddiq] and-to-the-wicked [ve-la-rasha], to-the-good [la-tov] and-to-the-clean [ve-la-tahor] and-to-the-unclean [ve-la-tame], and-to-the-one-who-sacrifices [ve-la-zove'ach] and-to-the-one-who-does-not-sacrifice [ve-la-asher einennu zove'ach]; as [ka-] the-good [ha-tov], so [ka-] the-sinner [ha-chote]; the-one-who-swears [ha-nishba] as [ka-asher] the-one-who-fears [yare] an-oath [shevu'ah].

**9:3** This [zeh] [is] an-evil [ra] in-all [be-khol] that-is-done [asher na'asah] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh]: that one-fate [miqreh echad] [is] to-all [la-kol]; and-also [ve-gam] the-heart [lev] of-the-sons [benei] of-the-human [ha-adam] [is] full [male] of-evil [ra], and-madness [holelot] [is] in-their-heart [bi-levavam] during-their-lives [be-chayyehem], and-after-it [ve-acharav] — to the-dead [el ha-metim].

**9:4** For whoever [mi asher] is-joined [yechubar] to all the-living [ha-chayyim] has [yesh] hope [bitachon]; for a-living [le-khelev chai] dog [is] better [tov] than a-dead [me-ha-aryeh ha-met] lion.

**9:5** For the-living [ha-chayyim] know [yod'im] that they-will-die [she-yamutu], but-the-dead [ve-ha-metim] know-nothing [einam yod'im me'umah], and-there-is-no-more [ve-ein od] reward [sakhar] for-them [lahem], for their-memory [zikhram] is-forgotten [nishkach].

**9:6** Also their-love [gam ahavatam] and-also their-hatred [gam sin'atam] and-also their-envy [gam qin'atam] has-already [kevar] perished [avadah]; and-a-portion [ve-cheleq] there-is-not [ein] for-them [lahem] any-more [od] forever [le-olam] in-all [be-khol] that is-done [asher na'asah] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh].

**9:7** Go [lekh], eat [ekhol] your-bread [lachmekha] with-joy [be-simchah], and-drink [u-sheteh] your-wine [yeinekha] with-a-good [be-lev tov] heart, for already [ki kevar] God [ha-Elohim] has-approved [ratzah] your-works [et ma'asekha].

**9:8** At-all-times [be-khol et] let-your-garments [begadekha] be white [levanim], and-oil [ve-shemen] on-your-head [al roshekha] let-it-not-lack [al yechsar].

**9:9** See [re'eh] life [chayyim] with the-wife [im ishah] whom you-love [asher ahavta], all the-days [kol yemei] of-your-vapor-life [chayyei hevlekha] which he-gave-you [asher natan lekha] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh], all your-vapor-days [kol yemei hevlekha]; for that [ki hu] [is] your-portion [chelqekha] in-life [ba-chayyim] and-in-your-toil [u-va-amalekha] that you [asher attah] toil [amel] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh].

**9:10** All [kol] that your-hand [yadekha] finds [timtza] to-do [la'asot], with-your-strength [be-khochacha] do [aseh]; for there-is-no [ki ein] work [ma'aseh] nor-reckoning [ve-cheshbon] nor-knowledge [ve-da'at] nor-wisdom [ve-chokhmah] in-Sheol [bi-she'ol] where [asher] you [attah] are-going [holekh] there [shammah].

**9:11** I-returned [shavti] and-saw [ve-ra'oh] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh] that not [lo] to-the-swift [la-qallim] [is] the-race [ha-merutzah], and-not [ve-lo] to-the-mighty [la-gibborim] the-battle [ha-milchamah], and-also-not [ve-gam lo] to-the-wise [la-chakhamim] bread [lechem], and-also-not [ve-gam lo] to-the-understanding [la-nevonim] riches [osher], and-also-not [ve-gam lo] to-the-knowing [la-yod'im] favor [chen]; for time [et] and-chance [va-fega] happen [yiqreh] to-all-of-them [et kullam].

**9:12** For also [ki gam] the-human [ha-adam] does-not-know [lo yeda] his-time [et itto]: like-fish [ka-dagim] that-are-caught [she-ne'echazim] in-a-net [bi-metzodah] of-evil [ra'ah], and-like-birds [u-kha-tzipporim] that-are-seized [ha-achuzot] in-a-snare [ba-pach] — like-them [ka-hem] the-sons [benei] of-the-human [ha-adam] are-snared [yuqashim] at-a-time [le-et] of-evil [ra'ah], when-it-falls [ke-she-tippol] upon-them [alehem] suddenly [pit'om].

**9:13** Also this [gam zoh] I-saw [ra'iti] [as] wisdom [chokhmah] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh], and-great [ve-gedolah] it [hi] [was] to-me [elai]:

**9:14** A-small [qetannah] city [ir] and-few [u-me'at] men [anashim] in-it [bah]; and-there-came [u-va] to-it [eleha] a-great [gadol] king [melekh] and-surrounded [ve-savav] it [otah] and-built [u-vanah] against-it [aleha] great [gedolim] siege-works [metzodim].

**9:15** And-there-was-found [u-matza] in-it [vah] a-man [ish] poor [misken] [and] wise [chakham], and-he [ve-hu] delivered [millat] the-city [et ha-ir] by-his-wisdom [be-chokhmato]; but-no-one [ve-adam lo] remembered [zakhar] that poor [ha-misken] man [ha-ish ha-hu].

**9:16** And-I-said [ve-amarti ani]: Better [tovah] [is] wisdom [chokhmah] than-might [mi-gevurah]; but-the-wisdom [ve-chokhmat] of-the-poor [ha-misken] is-despised [bezuyah], and-his-words [u-devarav] are-not-heard [einam nishma'im].

**9:17** The-words [divrei] of-the-wise [chakhamim] in-quietness [be-nachat] are-heard [nishma'im] more-than-the-cry [mi-za'aqat] of-a-ruler [moshel] among-fools [ba-kesilim].

**9:18** Better [tovah] [is] wisdom [chokhmah] than-weapons [mi-kelei] of-war [qerav], and-one [ve-chote echad] sinner destroys [ye'abbed] much [harbeh] good [tovah].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.4 — "a living dog is better than a dead lion":** The dog (*kelev*) was the most despised animal in ancient Israel (see 1 Sam 17:43, 2 Sam 9:8). The lion (*aryeh*) was the noblest. Qoheleth's proverb inverts the value hierarchy: any life is better than any death, because the living still have consciousness and hope.

**v.7-9 — The great enjoyment passage:** This is Qoheleth's most expansive and detailed enjoyment refrain, with echoes of the Mesopotamian *Epic of Gilgamesh* (Tablet X, the ale-wife Siduri's advice): "Let your garments be white, let your head not lack oil."

**v.11 — "time and chance":** The Hebrew *et va-fega* — time (*et*) and occurrence/chance (*pega*) — is Qoheleth's most concise statement about the unpredictability of outcomes. Merit does not guarantee success.

*-- EMET*
